items.title: Work with pull requests and merge requests from GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, and Codeberg
Edit files directly in the web and desktop apps
Oh My Pi (OMP) as a native agent provider
Open the complete Changes view as a workspace tab
Add files to chat directly from Files and Changes
Browse workspace commit history and open individual commit diffs from Changes
Switch models from the Command Center for active agents and new drafts
Open existing agents from Paseo links or the CLI
Configure workspace service ports with a fixed range or external allocator
Search keyboard shortcuts by action, note, or key combination
Turn thinking off for supported Claude models
Open workspace files in more installed editors and file managers
Remove individual custom providers from Settings
Selector popovers stay readable on iPad
Projects, workspaces and chat syncing is more efficient
CLI and MCP tools manage workspaces, agents, and schedules more consistently
Pasted PR/MR links in the composer become auto-selected as a checkout option
Idle agents release processes automatically and resume when needed
New Claude and Codex agents default to safer automatic approval modes when supported
Permission and thinking changes made during a turn now show when they take effect
Usage bars now warn as provider limits approach
Workspace focus mode stays confined to the active workspace with a visible exit control
Desktop installs the newest available update instead of a cached older release
Remote daemon update failures now show specific recovery steps
Agent history errors now appear immediately instead of after a timeout
Terminal pairing QR codes remain scannable in narrow terminals
Workspace creation stays responsive even with many active or archived workspaces
Failed agent starts no longer leave provider processes running
Completed OpenCode turns stay idle when late metadata updates arrive
ACP image prompts no longer appear twice
Web chats stay pinned to the latest message at non-default browser zoom
Grouped tool-call loading animations display correctly
Notifications now open the correct workspace and agent
Archived agents can be restored directly from History
CLI agent runs stay in the current workspace unless a new workspace is requested
Reused branches no longer attach an unrelated merged or closed pull request
Pi compaction waits for long summaries instead of reporting a false timeout
Pi chats keep new messages aligned with the correct history after an idle agent resumes
OpenCode follow-ups triggered by completed background work now remain visible
Codex no longer shows the parent agent as a phantom subagent
Oh My Pi background notices appear as task notifications instead of raw system text
Local dictation now works in Nix-packaged installations
The composer remains visible after submitting dictated text and returning to the app
Desktop's dictation shortcut remains responsive after finishing a recording
Projects can be renamed before their first workspace
Settings keep showing a connected remote host when the local daemon is stopped
Pinned workspaces no longer disappear briefly when reopening the compact sidebar
Terminal panes no longer remain at 80x24 after focus or visibility changes
Sign-in popups in the desktop browser now complete successfully
Browser typing and shortcuts no longer submit the active Paseo prompt
Agent browser tabs remain controllable after switching workspaces
Archived workspaces now show the correct Unarchive or Restore action
Archived sessions can be reimported into the current workspace
Browser shortcuts no longer appear where browser tabs are unavailable
